articles.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
articles.description: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony.ai and Nvidia
articles.description: inDrive plans to begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027.
articles.author: Jagmeet Singh

articles.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
articles.description: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
articles.description: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Canva releases its first image generation model
articles.description: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
articles.description: OpenAI is launching its decision model to the world. Can it compete with the original Jev?
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
articles.description: Microsoft’s new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a study in Science. But most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
articles.description: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.
articles.author: Zack Whittaker

articles.title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
articles.description: The ride-share giant previously deployed a much smaller pilot for ChatGPT Work but is now taking the enterprise agent company-wide.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Spotify’s current AI bet is about being the music service that agents choose
articles.description: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström explains why the rise of AI agents could be good news for the music service.
articles.author: Lauren Forristal
